summary: Lesaka Technologies, Inc., via its subsidiary Lesaka Technologies Proprietary Limited, entered into a Transaction Implementation Agreement with Zero Research Proprietary Limited, Bank Zero Mutual Bank, and their shareholders. This is an acquisition of Bank Zero (a mutual bank). The filing covers an extension of the long-stop date from August 6, 2026, to January 31, 2027, while waiting for outstanding regulatory consents. No financial terms (price per share, premium, break fee) are disclosed. The board recommendation is not provided, and no advisors are named. The structure involves the acquisition of a South African mutual bank. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline; the extension suggests delays, a key risk-arb factor.
